last.verdict: Shrinking sales outweighed higher profit and a raised outlook, so shares slipped slightly.

reasons.label: Sales fell sharply
reasons.text: Revenue dropped to $790.2M from $972.2M, hurt by last year's Switch 2 launch and store closures.

reasons.label: Profit jumped
reasons.text: Net income rose to $298.7M from $168.6M; adjusted EPS of $0.27 matched expectations.

reasons.label: Outlook nudged up
reasons.text: Full-year adjusted EBITDA forecast raised to over $650M from over $600M.

story: Recent reports have beaten estimates, with Q1 sales up 14% to $835.3M, wider margins and a $2B buyback. Yet the average first-day reaction has been about -1%. Investors keep watching the proposed eBay acquisition more than the quarterly numbers.
